# v1.3.6 — App Store fidelity for Library tabs & History

- Library: the Bookmarks/History segmented control is now inset 16px so it
  aligns with the view title, with equal-width segments (a proper iOS
  segmented control) instead of a full-width, content-width pill row.
- History (App Store themes): each day group renders as its own rounded inset
  card with the section header above it, hairline-separated rows, a subtle
  circular per-row delete button, a theme-aware chevron, and a centered swipe
  action; the sticky History toolbar is now frosted glass.
- Dark (Legacy) and Light (Legacy) themes keep their existing History styling.
